DEPLOYMENT / OPERATIONS

Check that the service can finish the job.

Operations tooling that tests a real model response as well as whether the API process is running.

ProjectClaude Code Server Ops
ScopePublic operations tooling
StackBash · Python · systemd · HTTP · SSE

The problem

An HTTP health endpoint can respond successfully while the service cannot produce a completion. Deployment also needs repeatable service configuration and checks for the capabilities clients actually use.

My contribution

  • Built scripts for configuring a systemd service and preparing its environment.
  • Implemented completion-based health probes and smoke checks for text, streaming, tools, images and session behavior.
  • Added scratch-instance support, configurable ports and exit codes suitable for deployment gates.

How the system works

Service configurationStart processCompletion probeCapability checksRelease decision

Keep the upstream server separate. This repository contains operations tooling for an upstream Claude Code API server, rather than presenting that server implementation as its own.

Check meaningful behavior. The smoke suite exercises actual client flows, including streaming and tool continuations.

Make checks usable in deployment. Dry-run installation and failure exit codes help integrate verification into a controlled release process.

What you can verify

The repository provides service scripts, a Python standard-library smoke suite, configuration examples and troubleshooting notes. Reviewers can inspect the exact checks used to accept a deployment.

Source repositoryUsage and smoke checks

Scope & limitations

Service installation requires Linux with systemd and a separately installed upstream server. Deep probes make real model calls. Restart and session behavior depend on the upstream version and are checked explicitly.
